verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is a SaaS email product, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents an MCP connector but nothing about API versioning, version identifiers, or deprecation and sunset policies. Probes for OpenAPI specs at the candidate paths all returned 404, which supports the absence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
